newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia RTS shares index sets record 355.94.
newsitem.headline: Russia RTS shares index sets record 355.94.

text.p: The Russian Trading System 22-share index rose to a record 355.94 at 1200 GMT on Monday, the NAUFOR brokers association said.
The index closed at 338.53 on Thursday, the previous day of trade, and traders said volumes were healthy.
Shares in national power utility UES EESR.RTS rose sharply on news global depositary receipts would begin trading on international markets on Monday.
UES shares finished the day around $0.3100, off a daily high, and record, of over 34 cents and up from $0.2798 on Thursday.
Traders also said that an overhang of Western buying orders from Friday, when Russian markets were closed, had spurred trade.
